description: The signed-in couple's own wedding registry on Zola: add 1 cash fund, with a name, a goal in US cents and an optional note for guests. Guests give any amount toward the goal ("Any amount they'd like" on zola.com). The goal is required, as on zola.com: if the couple names no amount, ask the couple. goal_hidden true hides the goal and the amount given from guests. The fund gets the plain cash fund picture: the couple changes it on zola.com. Guests see the fund on the registry at once. Status possible_duplicate: the registry has a cash fund with this name, and Zola added nothing. To change that fund, use zola_update_my_registry_cash_fund. If the couple wants a second fund with this name, give the match_id of each match in ignore_match_ids. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

goal_cents.description: The goal in US cents ("Total cash goal" on zola.com): 500000 is $5,000. Guests give any amount toward it. Required, as on zola.com: when the couple names no amount, ask her

goal_hidden.description: true hides the goal and the amount given from guests ("Hide total" on zola.com). Default false

ignore_match_ids.description: The match_id of each fund of a possible_duplicate preview, when the couple says that she wants a second fund with this name

name.description: The name that guests see, for example Honeymoon Fund

note.description: A short note for guests, in the couple's words

name: zola_add_my_registry_cash_fund

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a cash fund added to the registry of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the registry

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_add_my_registry_cash_fund with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

record_count.description: The new cash funds that change

records.description: The new cash funds with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_search_my_registry_items gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Add My Registry Cash Fund
